title: Resolve same-name eligible sources deterministically to the newest ACCEPTED producer (R1: exact-name precedence + ordering; R2: commit-boundary TOCTOU re-proof)
required_tests: src/__tests__/pair-hotfix-a-cross-mission-input.test.ts#exact match wins over a NEWER outbox alias (never displaced)
src/__tests__/pair-hotfix-a-cross-mission-input.test.ts#v3 lands inside the planner window → commit fails closed, zero revisions
src/__tests__/pair-hotfix-a-cross-mission-input.test.ts#v3 lands between PREPARED staging and commit → fail closed
src/__tests__/pair-hotfix-a-cross-mission-input.test.ts#durable PREPARED resume — drift at resume-commit → fail closed
src/__tests__/pair-hotfix-a-cross-mission-input.test.ts#no drift → PREPARED commits once, receipt + supersede land

description: BASE 43de5e4. LATEST_ACCEPTED + R1 corrections + R2 commit-boundary TOCTOU closure. Winner selection: EXACT logical_name outranks outbox/<basename> aliases (alias binds only when all aliases collapse to ONE logical_name, else FAIL_CLOSED AMBIGUOUS_SOURCE); ordering = parsed created_at epoch (missing/invalid = provably-oldest) then artifact_id — total order, never insertion order. R2-F1: runPlanning now re-resolves the canonical eligible set inside store.immediate alongside assertPlanDataflow+commitPlan — the planner-call window can no longer commit a stale pin; drift/revocation → FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_DATAFLOW_SOURCE_BINDING, check+write share the serialized writer. R2-F2: commitPreparedReplan re-fetches eligible sources inside its existing commit transaction and re-proves fresh.prepared_tasks (bind + assert) before commitPlan — resume-commit drift fails closed pre-revision, no supersede, no fake receipt; the already-committed replay branch never re-proves so valid post-commit drift can't retro-fail. Recovery state machine untouched: the throw lands in recoveryGuard→handleRecoveryApplyFailure → REPLAN infeasible → fresh decision under a new recovery_id, bounded, no infinite replay. R2 tests drive REAL runtime seams: bound-mission runPlanning, dispatch-failure→REPLANNING→staging→commit, durable PREPARED resume via ReplanAttemptLedger.record. R2-T1/T2/T3/T5 failing-first verified (stale pin committed pre-fix); T4/T6 positive controls prove no-drift initial+replan commits still land exactly once.
